youtube.baslik: How do you know a tympanometer measures correctly? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Immittance devices usually come with hard-walled calibration cavities of 0.5, 2 and 5 milliliters. At 226 Hz, one milliliter of air equals one millimho, so the device should read the cavity volume directly. A hard-walled cavity has no eardrum, so the tympanogram should be flat; a peak suggests a leak or a fault.
